fields.definition: A storage appliance that keeps its contents frozen.
fields.example: The frozen vegetables are in the freezer.
fields.brief: Show an open-topped retail chest freezer with baskets and a small amount of recognizably frozen packaged food. Use the chest construction and restrained cold/frost cues while keeping contents visible. Reject a plain cupboard, refrigerated milk cabinet, or exaggerated ice cavern. Inspect the Mini Market freezer lead and verify it is semantically distinct from the refrigerator card.

fields.definition: A region that uses the same standard local time.
fields.example: Check the time zone before joining the call.
fields.brief: Two fictional workplace meeting cards showing named time zones or cities, one explicit date, and correctly verified corresponding local times. Check daylight-saving offsets for that date; no unlabelled clock pair.

fields.definition: To establish that information is accurate by checking suitable evidence.
fields.example: Please verify the reference number against the order record.
fields.brief: A reference number compared with an authoritative order record.

fields.definition: The measured or labeled dimensions of a product.
fields.example: Which size would you like to try?
fields.brief: Context teaching only: show the same sourced garment in two verified sizes, supported by a readable explanation. Match camera scale and perspective; avoid body judgments or invented conversions between regional size labels. Do not score the larger-looking object alone as size.

fields.definition: A soft fiber from around the seeds of the cotton plant, used to make thread and cloth.
fields.example: The shirt is made from cotton.
fields.brief: Context teaching only: use a sourced, verified cotton-fiber photograph or illustration connecting an open cotton boll to clean textile fiber and a cloth sample. Do not show cotton candy, synthetic stuffing or an anonymous white cloud. A finished shirt alone cannot prove cotton composition.

fields.definition: Fiber from the fleece of sheep or similar animals, used for clothing.
fields.example: This wool sweater has a care label inside.
fields.brief: Context teaching only: use verified sourced wool fiber and yarn with a textile item, supported by a statement of its material. A yarn ball or knitted sweater alone could be synthetic. Avoid shearing procedures, animal distress or a label pretending to certify an unknown material.

fields.definition: Animal skin treated for use in shoes, bags, or other products.
fields.example: The bag has a leather strap.
fields.brief: Context teaching only: show a verified sourced finished leather sample or bag strap with a visible edge and stitching. Use a gentle retail presentation, with no raw hides or graphic animal imagery. Do not infer real leather from texture alone or replace it with a plastic lookalike.

fields.definition: A hard material made by firing clay or similar mineral substances at a high temperature.
fields.example: The bowl on the middle shelf is made of ceramic.
fields.brief: Context teaching only: show a verified sourced fired ceramic bowl with its finished surface and a small visible unglazed base, with material explained. Do not ask learners to distinguish ceramic from glass, resin or painted metal by shine alone; avoid a raw-clay lump as the finished material.

fields.definition: An extra item used with or worn with a main product.
fields.example: The camera bag is a useful accessory.
fields.brief: Context teaching only: show sourced camera-and-bag or other verified compatible product artwork, with the extra item identified by the sentence. The relation matters; an isolated bag is just a bag. Do not imply universal compatibility or include unlicensed brand marks.

fields.example: The mock records calls to the notification service.
fields.brief: A fictional controlled service substitute recording expected calls.

fields.definition: A claim that someone has done something wrong, which is not by itself an established fact.

fields.definition: The extent to which recorded data correctly represents the relevant facts.
fields.example: The team reviewed data accuracy before producing the report.
fields.brief: A fictional record being compared with an appropriate verified source.

fields.definition: To develop the intended properties of a material under the specified conditions and period.
